step1_analysis.description: A pseudo-differential amplifier acting as a transconductor (Gm cell) for an active complex filter in a low-IF Bluetooth receiver. It uses NMOS input transistors with PMOS active loads and relies on external common-mode feedback.

dc_power.description: Total DC power consumption of the Gm cell

sky130_expected.calculation: Id_p = 0.5 * 50uA/V^2 * (5/0.5) * (1.8V - 0.99V - 0.42V)^2 = 38uA per branch. Total current = 76uA. Power = 1.8V * 76uA = 136.8uW.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Calculated based on the provided PMOS bias voltage (0.99V) and SKY130 parameters.

sky130_expected.calculation: gm_n = 2*Id/Vov = 2*38uA/0.17V = 447uS. Rout = ro_n || ro_p = 263k || 263k = 131.5kOhm. Gain = gm_n * Rout = 58.8 V/V = 35.4 dB.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Open-loop gain of the Gm cell is typically higher than the closed-loop filter gain reported in the paper.

sky130_expected.calculation: f3dB = 1 / (2 * pi * Rout * Cload) = 1 / (2 * pi * 131.5kOhm * 100fF) = 12.1 MHz.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Bandwidth is determined by the output resistance and the assumed 100fF load capacitance. It must be > 2MHz to pass the IF signal.

sky130_expected.calculation: Input differential amplitude is 0.02V. Gain is 58.8. Output swing = 0.02V * 58.8 = 1.176V.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Linear amplification of the 10mV peak input signals.

step3_testbench.description: Testbench to measure DC power, differential AC gain, bandwidth, and transient output swing of the pseudo-differential Gm cell. Includes an ideal CMFB to stabilize the high-impedance output nodes.
step3_testbench.spice:
* Testbench for Pseudo-Differential Gm Cell
.lib "${SKY130_PDK}" tt

.param W_xm1=5u L_xm1=0.5u
.param W_xm2=5u L_xm2=0.5u
.param W_xm3=5u L_xm3=0.5u
.param W_xm4=5u L_xm4=0.5u

XM1 IO_PLUS VI_MINUS GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm1} w={W_xm1}
XM2 IO_MINUS VI_PLUS GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm2} w={W_xm2}
XM3 IO_PLUS VB VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm3} w={W_xm3}
XM4 IO_MINUS VB VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm4} w={W_xm4}

VVDD VDD 0 1.8
VVB VB 0 0.99

* Input common mode voltage
.param VCM=0.59
VIN_PLUS VI_PLUS 0 dc {VCM} ac 0.5 sin({VCM} 0.01 2Meg 0 0 0)
VIN_MINUS VI_MINUS 0 dc {VCM} ac -0.5 sin({VCM} 0.01 2Meg 0 0 180)

* Ideal CMFB to set output common-mode to 0.9V without affecting differential gain
B_CMFB1 IO_PLUS 0 I='(0.9 - (v(IO_PLUS)+v(IO_MINUS))/2) * 1e-3'
B_CMFB2 IO_MINUS 0 I='(0.9 - (v(IO_PLUS)+v(IO_MINUS))/2) * 1e-3'

* Load capacitors
CL1 IO_PLUS 0 100f
CL2 IO_MINUS 0 100f

* Differential output for easy measurement
E_DIFF VDIFF 0 vol='v(IO_PLUS) - v(IO_MINUS)'

.control
* DC Analysis
op
let power = -i(VVDD) * 1.8
print power
print v(IO_PLUS) v(IO_MINUS)

* AC Analysis
ac dec 100 1k 10G
let gain_db = 20 * log10(mag(v(VDIFF)))

meas ac dc_gain_db find gain_db at=10k
let gain_3db = dc_gain_db - 3
meas ac f3db when gain_db=gain_3db fall=1
meas ac unity_gbw when gain_db=0 fall=1

* Transient Analysis
tran 10n 2u
meas tran vout_max max v(VDIFF)
meas tran vout_min min v(VDIFF)
let swing = vout_max - vout_min
print swing

quit
.endc
